sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, which 
 must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title 
 block.

This 
 relay is connected between the primary or secondary winding of transformer and 
 the neutral and making as differential. The setting is less than the 
 differential relay and operated when the fault occurred on winding of 
 transformer. (look at figure no. 1)

The ( MCAG14 ) making 
 restricted earth fault relay between the winding of transformer and earth ( 
 neutral )

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Fahmy Abdel Khalek, tested by eng. Hanan El-Badrawy, revised 
 by quality control eng. Adel Abdel Kader ElNagar at EDEPCo., accepted 
 by general director eng. Mahmoud Sakerd, approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of TAlkha PS, 
 certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy: EDEPCo. Inspection and quality control 
 head sector.

Also this document reviewed by engineers: Samy Abdou Sayed, Hany 
 Bassuny, Mahmoud Badawy, Gamal Abdel Wahab and approved by Dr. Sarwat Sabry at 
 El Kureimat PS and certified by eng. Mohamed Hassan Gomaa UEEPCo. Inspection 
 and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category.

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Safety and 
 Healthy equipment must be used (safety 
 Helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).

Make sure C.T.'s secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming 
 terminal blocks before isolating the relay current circuit for test
